sources.title: What is safeguarding?
sources.verified_claim: CAA explains that officially safeguarded aerodromes are statutory consultees and safeguarding maps trigger consultation for specified development heights. A safeguarding framework does not establish a clear height envelope for a sample parcel without the relevant aerodrome map and proposal details.

sources.title: Frequently Asked Questions
sources.verified_claim: CAA notes cranes and tall construction equipment can affect obstacle surfaces and CNS systems and may require aerodrome permits depending on location and height. These requirements are safety-process inputs, not parcel planning permission.

sources.title: Safeguarding of IFP
sources.verified_claim: CAA requires separate assessment of proposed development and temporary obstacles against current and possible future instrument flight procedures. No candidate impact is inferred without a scheme-specific assessment.

sources.title: Lighting and marking of obstacles
sources.verified_claim: CAA explains obstacle lighting and marking depend on structure height, location and aerodrome safeguarding context, with safeguarding zones potentially extending well beyond runway thresholds. General thresholds are not an exact candidate height clearance.

sources.title: 2. Making best use of land and achieving Good Growth
sources.verified_claim: The Draft London Plan proposes a framework for buildings 30m and above and requires aviation, navigation and telecommunication impacts to be addressed. Draft status is retained and no sample parcel is treated as suitable by default.

sources.title: New Enfield Local Plan
sources.verified_claim: Enfield publishes Regulation 19 tall-building maps as part of an emerging plan under examination. Emerging map content is not treated as adopted parcel_30762 height permission.

sources.title: Havering Character Study
sources.verified_claim: Havering's Character Study supports the new Local Plan and explores medium-high density intensification and tall buildings, while emphasising local context. Character evidence does not establish parcel_46142 suitability or maximum height.

sources.title: Topic papers
sources.published_at: 2026 current evidence page; tall-building topic paper older
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth's evidence base includes a dedicated tall-buildings topic paper. The source is relevant planning evidence but its age and plan context are retained, and no parcel_61522 height conclusion is inferred.
